subject: Urgent: Post-call recap + Hosted-to-Dedicated decision for FinServe incident
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Klein <sophie.klein@finserve.io>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@finserve.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: hosting vs dedicated / next steps (FinServe)

Thanks again for the call today, Sophie - quick recap and next steps from our side.

Summary:
- Observed issue: recurring capacity spike during month-end billing job that pushed request volume ~5x above baseline and caused tail latency >5s for critical endpoints.
- Immediate need: predictable throughput and lower latency during heavy windows; also concerned about data isolation for audit.
- Options we discussed: stay on Hosted (with temporary quota/priority), move to Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool), or Private VPC/on-prem for strict compliance.

Attachments: incident_summary.pdf (short summary), api_logs_2026-06-18.txt (logs you shared).

What we need from you to propose a concrete plan:
1) Traffic profile: daily qps + 95/99 latency buckets for the past 30 days (if available).
2) Models in use (name + approximate peak token length).
3) Any compliance constraints (SOC2, data residency) that would push you to Private VPC.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- If you confirm this is urgent, we can propose an emergency hosted capacity bump for 72 hrs while we scope a Dedicated migration.
- Connor (cc'ed) can run a quick capacity estimate once we have traffic specifics.
- Rishi (cc'ed) can advise on compliance/timeline for Private VPC if needed.

Can you confirm the priority and share the traffic profile? If urgent, happy to stand up a 30-min working session today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Sophie Klein <sophie.klein@finserve.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@finserve.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: hosting vs dedicated / next steps (FinServe)

Laura - thanks for the summary and fast follow-up. This is urgent.

What happened: our billing batch yesterday retried a large set of invoices and resulted in a 5x burst in token calls for our reconciliation model. Production latency spiked and several customers reported timeouts during payment processing windows. This is blocking revenue.

We attached the API logs you asked for (api_logs_2026-06-18.txt). Short answers to your questions:
- Traffic profile: baseline ~120 qps, with spikes up to ~600 qps at peak; 95/99 latencies pushed over 3s/5s respectively during the incident.
- Model: open-llama-13b (quantized); typical prompt lengths ~600 tokens, responses ~120 tokens.
- Compliance: we are SOC2 in progress; currently fine with Hosted but need auditability.

Immediate ask: can Redwood provide an emergency capacity bump (priority serving or temporary dedicated pool) today/tomorrow while we evaluate Dedicated or Private? Also need an estimate: how long to fully migrate to Dedicated capacity and typical impact on latency/cost.

Thanks - Sophie
Sophie Klein
Director, Platform Engineering | FinServe
sophie.klein@finserve.io
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: hosting vs dedicated / next steps (FinServe)

Connor / Rishi - forwarding Sophie and Tom's note + logs. Verified: 5x spike to ~600 qps, open-llama-13b (quantized), prompt ~600 tokens.

Ask: Sophie asked for an emergency capacity bump today/tomorrow and an estimate/time-to-migrate to Dedicated. Can you propose a quick plan (temp mitigation + migration path) and call out any blockers (security/compliance, data isolation)? Sophie indicated this is blocking revenue so quick turnaround important.

Attachments included: api_logs_2026-06-18.txt, incident_summary.pdf.

If possible, please suggest ETA for a hosted burst (hours) and a realistic Dedicated migration timeline (days).

Thanks - Laura

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Sophie Klein <sophie.klein@finserve.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: hosting vs dedicated / next steps (FinServe)
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@finserve.io>

(Attached: api_logs_2026-06-18.txt)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sophie Klein <sophie.klein@finserve.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap: hosting vs dedicated / next steps (FinServe)

Laura / Sophie - saw the logs, thanks for sending. Quick plan below: 

Short-term (immediate, 0-72 hrs):
- We can provision a temporary hosted capacity bump (priority serving + burst nodes) within 2-4 hours for a limited window. That will reduce tail latency while we scope migration. This is a platform-config change (no infra change on FinServe side).
- Expected impact: should bring 99p latency under 1.5s for the reconciliation endpoints assuming model size / token lengths remain as reported.
- Requirements: confirmation of desired time window and an authorized contact for emergency scaling (Sophie/Tom).

Medium-term (Dedicated migration, 7-10 business days):
- Plan: reserve a Dedicated GPU pool sized for observed 600 qps peak + 30% buffer. We'll run a quick perf test with your model (we'll need the model artifact or weights access and a smoke dataset).
- Tasks: capacity sizing, provisioning, test run, cutover plan, DNS/endpoint swap.
- Need from FinServe: model access (or link to model), sample prompt set, and confirmation of peak concurrency SLOs.

Long-term (Private VPC):
- If SOC2/data isolation required, Private VPC is possible but adds security review and ~3-6 week lead time depending on KMS/HSM integrations and network approvals.

I've attached a short migration_playbook_stub.pdf with the steps and a rough cost estimate.

Next step: Sophie, can we schedule a 30-min technical call tomorrow morning (options: 9:00am or 11:00am PT) to lock down the immediate window and gather model artifacts? If you approve, I can trigger the hosted burst immediately.

-Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Sophie Klein <sophie.klein@finserve.io>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap: hosting vs dedicated / next steps (FinServe)

Adding a quick compliance/ops note:
- If FinServe is comfortable with Hosted + emergency burst, we can proceed quickly (hours). We'll capture audit logs and an incident ticket for the surge. That path minimizes time-to-resolution.
- Dedicated migration timeline of 7-10 business days looks right for standard Dedicated (assuming no custom network or KMS).

Sophie: please share your SOC2 timeline and whether isolation (no shared tenancy) is a hard requirement for go/no-go. Also need the tenant id and the exact API key ids involved so we can map rate limits back to the correct account.

If you want, we can provision a 72-hour hosted bump today as Connor suggested; I will follow up with an operations ticket once you approve.

-Rishi
Head of Platform Security & Reliability | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
From: Sophie Klein <sophie.klein@finserve.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap: hosting vs dedicated / next steps (FinServe)

Thanks, everyone. Please proceed with the 72-hour hosted bump starting ASAP. I can join the technical call tomorrow at 11:00am PT.

SOC2 status: in progress, audit scheduled Q4. For now, isolation is NOT a hard requirement, but we will need audit logs and an SSO integration before formal acceptance.

Tenant ID: finserve-prod-003
API key ids: ak_live_78f3, ak_live_88c1

Appreciate the fast help - this is blocking our billing window.

-Sophie
